p1: Long ago in Jerusalem, many of Heavenly Father’s people had stopped doing good.
So the Lord gave Isaiah a message for them: “Wash, and make yourselves clean.” He did not mean a bath! He wanted to wash the wrong things out of their hearts.
“Stop doing wrong,” the Lord said. “Learn to do good.” Then He said, “Come now,” and made a happy promise.
p2: “Your sins may be bright red, but they will be white as snow.” Why red? A red stain is very hard to wash out. But the Lord can make any heart clean, white as snow. The Lord is Jesus.
Do you feel sorry for something? Tell Jesus about it tonight. He can make your heart clean and new.
old: Long ago, Heavenly Father sent a prophet named Isaiah to share His messages. One of Isaiah’s most beautiful messages was full of love and hope.
Sometimes people made wrong choices, and their hearts felt dark and heavy, like a shirt with big red stains.
But Heavenly Father said something wonderful through Isaiah: “Come, let’s talk it over. Even if your mistakes are as red as scarlet, I can make you as white and clean as fresh snow!”
Isn’t that amazing? When we’re truly sorry and come to Heavenly Father, He washes our hearts pure and clean — whiter than the whitest snow.
No mistake is too big for Heavenly Father’s love. He always welcomes us back and makes us clean and new. That is His happy promise to you.
